title: Marie, Elie & Anis no Atelier - Soyokaze kara no Dengon (Japan)

fields.name: save_magic_atelier2
fields.description: Save-block magic header 'ATELIER2' at EEPROM blocks 0x3AC-0x3AC (file offset = eeprom_addr * 8)
fields.evidence: FUN_08032644 compares the first 8 bytes of the 0x230-byte RAM save buffer against the expected header (uVar4 == 8 check); FUN_080326ec re-initializes those 8 bytes on validation failure; baseline logical bytes at save offsets 7520-7527 read 'ATELIER2'.

fields.name: save_data_u32_0
fields.description: First 32-bit word of the save payload after the magic header (zero in fresh baseline; covered by sum32)
fields.evidence: FUN_080326a0 loads EEPROM blocks 0x3AC-0x3F1 (file offsets 7520-8079) 8 bytes at a time via FUN_0804618c into a 0x230-byte RAM buffer; FUN_08032744 writes it back via FUN_08046370; FUN_08032550 checksums the whole 0x230-byte region. Baseline logical word at 7528 is 0x00000000.

fields.name: save_data_u32_1
fields.description: Second 32-bit word of the save payload (zero in fresh baseline; covered by sum32)
fields.evidence: Same block transfer as save_data_u32_0: FUN_080326a0 / FUN_0804618c load path and FUN_08032744 / FUN_08046370 store path move this word as part of EEPROM blocks 0x3AC-0x3F1; FUN_08032550 includes it in the sum32. Baseline logical word at 7532 is 0x00000000.

fields.name: save_flags_a
fields.description: 16-bit flags slot in the save payload head (zero in fresh baseline; covered by sum32)
fields.evidence: FUN_080326a0 / FUN_08032744 transfer this halfword inside the 0x230-byte save block (EEPROM blocks 0x3AC-0x3F1) via FUN_0804618c / FUN_08046370; FUN_08032550 covers it with the sum32. Baseline logical halfword at 7536 is 0x0000.

fields.name: save_flags_b
fields.description: Second 16-bit flags slot in the save payload head (zero in fresh baseline; covered by sum32)
fields.evidence: FUN_080326a0 / FUN_08032744 transfer this halfword inside the 0x230-byte save block (EEPROM blocks 0x3AC-0x3F1) via FUN_0804618c / FUN_08046370; FUN_08032550 covers it with the sum32. Baseline logical halfword at 7538 is 0x0000.

fields.name: save_data_main
fields.description: Bulk save payload (all zero in fresh baseline; covered by sum32)
fields.evidence: FUN_080326a0 loops uVar2 over 0x46 (70) EEPROM blocks from base 0x3AC via FUN_0804618c, covering file offsets 7520-8079; FUN_08032744 writes the same span back via FUN_08046370; FUN_08032550 checksums bytes [base, base+556). Baseline logical bytes 7540-8067 are all 0x00.

fields.name: save_data_tail
fields.description: Final 8 payload bytes immediately before the sum32 trailer (all zero in fresh baseline)
fields.evidence: Last payload bytes of the 0x230-byte block loaded by FUN_080326a0 (EEPROM block 0x3F1 tail) via FUN_0804618c and stored by FUN_08032744 via FUN_08046370; covered by the FUN_08032550 sum32 whose result lands at offset 8076. Baseline logical bytes 8068-8075 are all 0x00.
